desc: 青蓝几何拱门展台系统，讲透干爽隔离与表层亲肤触感的婴儿隔尿垫详情页套图
name: 宝宝隔尿垫清爽护理款

shots.intent: 用高亮青蓝拱门与白色展台把包装本体推到搜索首屏，一眼看清是什么、给谁用。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline block 「{selling_point_1}」 at 48pt with a lighter subtitle 「{callout_1}」 at 16pt beneath and a blue pill label 「{callout_2}」; the two icon tiles are captioned 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」 at 12pt

shots.intent: 用同机位四格情境把最刺眼的换洗麻烦摊开，让买家在第二屏就点头。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_2}」 at 40pt in #0E6FA8 with a thin outlined pill 「{callout_5}」 at 14pt beneath; one solid blue caption bar #1A8FD6 with short white type under each tile reading 「{callout_6}」; four filled white circular pictograms on the bottom band captioned 「{callout_7}」 at 12pt

shots.intent: 用一张表层微距把亲肤触感和导流纹路做成看得见的证据，替代一切口头承诺。
shots.textZone: top white strip carries the headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 32pt in #0E6FA8 plus one short label 「{callout_8}」 at 14pt; a hairline leader ties the label to the embossed grid

shots.intent: 把垫片剥成扇形剖面并配上升气流箭头，一屏讲清隔离与透气的机制。
shots.textZone: right column carries headline 「{selling_point_3}」 at 34pt in #0E6FA8 with two short layer labels 「{callout_9}」 at 13pt tied by hairline leaders; layer count never written as words or numerals

shots.intent: 同机位同光双格对照，让买家自己看见表面是否还干爽。
shots.textZone: one solid blue caption bar #1A8FD6 with short white type under each panel, 「{callout_10}」 left and 「{callout_11}」 right, at 13pt; headline 「{selling_point_4}」 at 34pt in #0E6FA8 in the top band; no percentage badge and no arrow implying data

shots.intent: 用俯视三步动线教会买家怎么铺、铺在哪，把功能转成使用习惯。
shots.textZone: three small white numbered circle markers down the left margin each with a short label 「{callout_12}」 at 13pt; one caption line 「{callout_13}」 at 16pt in #0E6FA8 at the bottom

shots.intent: 低机位把垫片放进真实睡眠场景，给出尺寸感与安心感的氛围证据。
shots.textZone: one small caption strip in the upper-left clean zone reading 「{callout_14}」 at 14pt in #0E6FA8; no headline and no body text

shots.intent: 把包装、展开片与折叠片同框平铺，一步解决选规格与看形态的疑问。
shots.textZone: lower white card #FFFFFF carries three short option labels 「{callout_15}」 at 14pt in #0E6FA8 beside thin dimension leaders, values supplied as placeholders rather than fixed numbers

shots.intent: 用规整参数卡与实拍同框收口疑虑，把下单前最后一次核对做完。
shots.textZone: blue band carries white type 「{selling_point_5}」 at 34pt with a thin sub-line 「{callout_16}」 at 14pt and three pagination dots; the card carries a large title placeholder 「{callout_17}」 at 28pt in #0E6FA8, four label rows reading 「{callout_18}」 at 14pt, and a solid blue pill 「{callout_19}」 at 14pt in white type

shots.intent: 以收口主张加一个行动按钮结束详情页，承接加购决策。
shots.textZone: lower deep band carries the CTA pill 「{callout_20}」 at 18pt in white type plus one supporting line 「{callout_21}」 at 13pt; upper-right clean zone carries a short line 「{selling_point_1}」 at 22pt in #0E6FA8; no QR code, no price, no membership wording

style.backgroundSystem: seamless high-key studio field made of a pale aqua wall #E8F5FC with one large soft-edged arch panel #CFEAF8 and stacked matte white plinth blocks #FFFFFF used as podiums; solid deep-blue wave bands #0E7CC4 mark section breaks; only the two lifestyle screens swap to a real bedroom or play-floor field; no scenery beyond the arch, no gradients outside the arch field
style.direction: clinical-fresh aqua nursery ecommerce, high-key geometric studio commerce for diapering care disposables
style.iconSystem: solid rounded-square tiles in #1A8FD6 each carrying one white single-weight pictogram, filled white circular pictograms on the deep-blue band, small white numbered circle markers for sequences; one icon per short label, all on one baseline; no cartoon illustration, no 3D icons, no filled colour icons
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key front-left soft source at about 6000K, crisp specular highlight on the film packaging, soft wrapped contact shadow under every plinth and pad edge, no hard shadow, no rim flash; lifestyle screens use about 5000K window daylight from camera-left with the same soft-shadow logic
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical-fresh aqua nursery ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pale aqua studio wall #E8F5FC, soft arch panel #CFEAF8, deep lake-blue headline type #0E6FA8, bright icon tile blue #1A8FD6, matte white plinth and card #FFFFFF, deep band blue #0E7CC4 and one mint accent #7FC24A, with any product-derived accent supplied as {accent_color}; cool overall temperature, warm-neutral only inside the two lifestyle fields; one rounded heavy Chinese sans display family for headlines plus one light geometric sans for body, headline type in #0E6FA8 on white and white type on blue, identical hierarchy on every screen; background is a seamless high-key studio field built from one large soft-edged arch panel with stacked matte white plinth blocks, and a real bedroom or play-floor field only on the two lifestyle screens; bright high-key front-left soft key at about 6000K with crisp specular on the film pack and soft wrapped contact shadows, about 5000K window daylight inside the lifestyle fields; layout uses solid rounded-square blue icon tiles with one white single-weight pictogram each, solid blue caption bars with short white type, rounded-corner white cards with a thin #1A8FD6 outline, small white numbered circle markers and a deep-blue wave band at section breaks; product shown upright at a stable three-quarter angle with the printed face to camera, pad shown flat, folded or fanned with the quilting, piping colour, layer edges and proportions of the reference kept faithful, never re-tinted, never floating without a contact shadow, liquid only ever one small contained bead sitting inside the frame; babies always anonymous and always supervised; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no gradient outside the arch field, no invented claims or figures.
noDrift: no gradient outside the arch field
no re-tinted packaging and no redesigned pack print
no altered quilting pattern, piping colour, layer edge or pad proportion
no antibacterial, anti-mite, disinfecting or medical-efficacy claim
no rash, dermatitis or skin-condition wording and no healing or prevention claim
no age or month indication and no usable-range statement
no material name, fibre, grade or origin claim
no invented layer count, piece count, dimension, weight or absorbency figure
no certificate, lab report, patent, award or test percentage
no visible identifiable baby face and no unsupervised baby
no liquid spill, run-off or puddle leaving the frame
style.presentationRules: pack shown upright at a stable three-quarter angle with its printed face to camera and never re-tinted; pad shown flat, folded or fanned with the quilting pattern, piping colour, visible layer edges and proportions of the reference kept faithful; nothing floats without a contact shadow; liquid appears only as one small contained bead sitting inside the frame; babies always anonymous and always supervised
style.surfaceSystem: matte lacquered white plinth blocks #FFFFFF on a pale aqua floor #DCEEF9 in the studio field; white quilted mattress cover #F4F6F8, cream shag carpet #E8DCCB and pale wood trim #DCC9AC in the lifestyle fields; nothing glossy, no plastic sheen on the pad face
style.typography: one rounded heavy Chinese sans display family for headlines plus one light geometric sans for body copy; headline type in #0E6FA8 on white and white on blue; solid blue caption bars and pill labels carry short white type; hierarchy, sizes and corner radii identical on every screen; all Chinese copy supplied as placeholders
